snippet.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Cost of Hope Announcement Trailer | Xbox Partner Preview 2026
snippet.description:
S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Cost of Hope is the first major expansion for the Zone, arriving in Summer 2026 on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC as an Xbox Play Anywhere title.

https://www.xbox.com/games/stalker-2

Be part of a massive storyline that unfolds around the conflict between two iconic factions — Duty and Freedom — and can take dozens of hours to complete. Visit the Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant and the Iron Forest regions, face new dangers, try new weapons, and uncover secrets previously hidden from humanity.
